subject: ACE readyset: NimbusData marketplace listing & PDM/PSM handoff
messages:
From: Claire Brooks <claire@NimbusData.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: ACE readyset: NimbusData marketplace listing & PDM/PSM handoff

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for taking a moment to connect at the Summit last week — Claire from NimbusData here. We had a product team follow-up and were keen to get started on the AWS co-sell path and Marketplace listing.

High-level ask: get ACE registration started and align your PDM/PSM with our GTM and technical owners so we can hit the Q1 launch windows. Were already through legal review and can sign NDAs quickly.

Quick context:
- Were targeting two Marketplace SKUs: an enterprise bring-your-own-license and a managed offering.
- Primary internal leads: Ethan Long (product) and myself.
- Timeline: get ACE intake submitted by mid-November to preserve co-sell eligibility for Jan campaigns.

Can you loop in the right PDM/PSM and share the registration checklist so were not missing anything?

Thanks,
Claire Brooks
Head of GTM Partnerships
NimbusData

From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
To: Claire Brooks <claire@NimbusData.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-28T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ACE readyset: NimbusData marketplace listing & PDM/PSM handoff

Hi Claire — great to hear from you and glad the Summit intro was useful. Looping in Aditya (partnerships / marketplace) and Laura (PDM) to coordinate the ACE intake and PSM alignment.

Next steps I propose:
1) Aditya: can you send the ACE registration checklist and any pre-work we should ask Nimbus to prepare?
2) Laura: please propose two 30-min slots for a PDM/PSM sync with Claire + Ethan next week.
3) Claire: if you can attach the product one-pager and confirm whether Nimbus will operate a managed SKU or BYOL first, that will help us scope listing assets.

Ill be the internal lead for this handoff — Ill track the intake and the HubSpot record once Aditya creates it. Thanks all,

—Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Partnerships (Marketplace)
Redwood Inference

From: aditya_rao@redwood.com
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com, Claire Brooks <claire@NimbusData.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-28T12:40:00-07:00
Subject: ACE checklist + next steps for NimbusData (attachments)

Hi Claire / team,

Thanks Hannah. Attached are the core artifacts to get ACE intake rolling: ACE_Readyset_Checklist.pdf (worksheets for SKU mapping, entitlement, co-sell opt-in, and listing metadata) and a stub NDA receipt (Nimbus_NDA_signed.pdf).

I summarize key items below so everyone has visibility:
- Marketplace SKUs: define canonical SKU names and pricing model (BYOL vs Managed). If youre planning a managed SKU well need a short operations runbook (1 page) explaining multi-tenant vs single-tenant options.
- Co-sell enablement: AWS requires a PDM/PSM contact + a brief success plan (three bullets on customer outcomes). Well own insertion to ACE portal but need your SOC2 statement and a public support contact.
- Technical assets: prod one-pager, architecture diagram, and sample billing/invoice line item.
- Timeline: recommend completing checklist items by 2026-11-15 to preserve co-sell review in December.

Attachments (stubs):
- ACE_Readyset_Checklist.pdf (stub)
- Nimbus_NDA_signed.pdf (stub)

Ive created the HubSpot deal and linked it here: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/9876543 — Ill populate the Marketplace field and set the owner to Hannah.

Let me know if you want us to run a short intake call (15-20 min) to walk the checklist. Otherwise Laura, do you have availability to join an intro PDM/PSM session next week?

Best,
Aditya Rao
Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: Claire Brooks <claire@NimbusData.com>, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-29T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ACE readyset: NimbusData marketplace listing & PDM/PSM handoff

Hi Claire — happy to meet. Im Laura, your assigned PDM for the AWS co-sell path. Quick availability windows (PST):
- Tue 2026-11-02: 10:00–10:30 or 14:00–14:30
- Wed 2026-11-03: 09:30–10:00 or 16:00–16:30

Proposed agenda (30 min):
- Intros + roles (5 min)
- Target SKUs and customer use cases (10 min)
- ACE checklist gaps and immediate asks (10 min)
- Next steps and owner assignments (5 min)

From Adityas list, two immediate asks for us to prep before the call:
1) Product one-pager (Claire / Nimbus) — can you drop the PDF into this thread (or upload to the HubSpot deal)?
2) SOC2 statement or link to compliance page — AWS needs this for co-sell eligibility.

Ive opened a Redwood internal support ticket to pull Marketplace listing templates and will share a draft listing template after our call. Also linking AWS ACE portal intake for reference: https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/solutions/ace/portal/registration/12345

Thanks — pick a slot and Ill send a calendar invite.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Product Director, Partner GTM (PDM)
Redwood Inference
